polygon.style: stroke-width: 0.00; stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; fill: #999999; fill-opacity: 0.50;

polyline.style: stroke-width: 1.07; stroke: #000000; stroke-opacity: 0.90; stroke-dasharray: 5.69,5.69; stroke-linecap: butt;

line.style: stroke-width: 1.07; stroke: #000000; stroke-opacity: 0.90; stroke-dasharray: 5.69,5.69; stroke-linecap: butt;

rect.style: stroke-width: 1.07; stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; fill: #999999; fill-opacity: 0.50;

g.text: Oi = Output i of the DGP emulator
NRMSE = Normalized Root Mean Squared Error
